jobs.jobDescription:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Megan Berry, Senior Director of Product Management at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Product Manager to improve how customers experience their first weeks with us. Our self-serve business is a growing part of how customers discover and adopt Customer.io, and this role sits at the center of that motion, working alongside our Senior PM on the self-serve pod. You'll have real ownership over a defined slice of the journey, with the data, experimentation muscle, and cross-functional partners to move it.

What we value

  • Customer empathy — you dig into what's actually slowing customers down, not just what the dashboard says.
  • Bias to experiment — you'd rather run a test than debate an opinion.
  • Clear communication — you make complex tradeoffs easy for others to follow.
  • Ownership without ego — you drive your area forward and know when to ask for help.

What you'll do

  • Own the product experience of of our own agent, working with our agent team to ensure it is first-class, competitive and helpful for the AI-first marketer who uses our platform.
  • Work closely with other PMs and squads to ensure the agent works well with each part of the platform it touches.
  • Find and resolve friction points using data, experimentation, and customer insight.
  • Define and track success metrics for activation, retention, and monetization.
  • Partner with Marketing, CX, and Design to ensure success across all touch points
  • Work with Engineering to scope and deliver improvements that produce customer value
  • Communicate priorities and progress clearly across teams and leadership.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of product management experience in SaaS, ideally with some experience PMing an agentic experience.
  • Experience using or developing AI-powered tooling in your product workflow
  • A track record of improving activation or retention metrics.
  • Strong analytical and experimentation skills — data-driven but comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Experience collaborating across Product, Marketing, and CX.
  • A clear communicator who simplifies complexity and drives alignment.
  • Deep curiosity about what helps customers succeed.
  • Comfort working autonomously in a remote, async-first environment.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $137k–$156k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

Zone 1: $164,400–$187,200.

Zone 2: $150,700–$171,600.

Zone 3: $137,000–$156,000.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute call with a Recruiter
  2. 30-minute video call with the Hiring Manager
  3. 60-minute Product Case discussion with Engineering team members
  4. 60-minute Product Case Review call with a panel

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.

Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Matt Wensing, VP of Product & Design at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Principal Product Designer. Principal Product Designer is the highest individual contributor design role at Customer.io. This person shapes the design vision for the company and influences how design is practiced here — through their own craft, through the standards their work sets, and through the partnerships they build with product and engineering leadership.

Customer.io is in a transformational moment: executing against a strong current product while redesigning what the product is and how it's experienced by a new generation of builders. This role has to straddle both — delivering quality and coherence in what exists today while driving the vision for where things go.

This is not a management role, but it's a leadership role in the fullest sense. Their influence is felt company-wide — in the product, in the culture, and in who we hire.

About you

You have a fully formed point of view on how AI changes what software means — for the people who use it, the people who build it, and the agents that increasingly operate it. You have the conviction to put that view to work across a product and an organization. You lead through clarity and example, give candid feedback that improves the work, and operate with humility and curiosity even outside your own expertise.

What we value

  • Leads through clarity and example, not control. You shape culture through your own practice — not top-down direction.
  • Candid craft feedback. You give feedback that improves the work, even when it's uncomfortable.
  • Humility and curiosity. You operate with openness, especially in areas outside your expertise.
  • Amplifying others. You raise the impact of people across the whole company — not just the design team.
  • Bias for craft. You stay close to the work by choice, and that proximity is how you lead.

Some things you'll do

  • Shape and communicate a design vision for Customer.io's product as a whole — the coherent, long-range picture of what excellent looks like for our customers, brought into rooms where product direction gets set
  • Drive the strategic direction of Pluma, our design system — architecture, evolution, deprecation decisions, and the principles that govern how it scales
  • Close the gap between design intent and shipped product — stay close enough to implementation to catch divergence, and fix it directly when code is the right tool
  • Design for builder and developer audiences — CLI-native flows, API-first onboarding, and interfaces built for people who type before they click
  • Lead the design of agentic and human-AI surfaces across the product — develop the philosophy and advocate for the standards
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership on product strategy — bring design into the conversation before direction is set, not after
  • Develop and advocate for Customer.io's AI product design philosophy as a framework the whole team builds from
  • Lead design review for major initiatives and bring accountability for quality and coherence across what ships
  • Develop Staff designers through direct mentorship, critique, and the clarity of your own example
  • Contribute to hiring and calibration — assess candidates with conviction and help the team develop a shared language for what excellent looks like

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years of product design experience with a portfolio demonstrating design vision and organizational impact, not just individual craft
  • Track record of shaping design direction at the company level — influenced what gets built and why, not just how it looks
  • Designed for developer and builder audiences — CLI, API-first onboarding, or infrastructure-native products
  • Developed point of view on AI and agentic product design — has shipped AI-native interfaces and can articulate a philosophy on interaction models for agentic and delegated use
  • Contributed to a design system at the strategic level — shaped what it should be and shouldn't be, and advocated for those decisions over time
  • Operates with influence without authority — track record of aligning product, engineering, and exec leadership around a design direction without a management title
  • Has raised the craft bar at an organizational level — through critique culture, standards, and the example others internalize
  • Executive-level communication — connects design decisions to customer impact, product differentiation, and business outcomes
  • B2B SaaS depth — understands complex, data-heavy products and has opinions about where the interaction model breaks

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. The starting salary for this role is $245k-$276k USD, depending on experience and subject to market-rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks of paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions — just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • 30 minute call with Recruiter
  • 45 minute call and portfolio review with Hiring Manager
  • 30 minute call with cross-functional partner
  • 60 minute design case call with members of the design & tech team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions, please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

People Partner

Hello, I’m Danielle, Senior Director, People Experience at Customer.io! We're expanding our people team in the United States and seeking a People Partner to support our global team in a fast-paced, innovative environment. This is a great fit for an HR professional with a few years of experience who's ready to deepen their impact as a partner to the business.

The People Partners at Customer.io are advocates for our people, leveraging their skills in data analytics, change management, and industry knowledge. They use these skills to enhance Customer.io’s transformation, agility, and efficiency, delivering meaningful outcomes for both our team members and the business.

You'll work alongside a cross-functional team to support talent management, development, retention, and organizational effectiveness. Strong communication, critical thinking, and a foundation in workforce planning will set you up for success. If you're passionate about contributing to a supportive, high-performing culture, we'd love for you to join our collaborative team.

About Customer.io

Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Some things you'll do:

  • Support business alignment: Partner with departmental leaders to understand business needs and help develop plans that build organizational capabilities and support growth.
  • Performance management: Own and elevate our review cycles end to end — lead the annual and bi-annual processes, guide calibration and compensation decisions, and coach managers to build accountability and develop talent across the team.
  • Employee relations: Guide managers and employees through day-to-day questions and concerns with fairness and sound judgment, fostering a positive, respectful work environment.
  • Organizational development: Help assess team structures and work with leaders to identify areas for improvement and put changes into practice.
  • Change management support: Support organizational change efforts and help build change-readiness across teams.
  • Leadership support: Build strong working relationships with managers to understand their needs in the context of business goals, and provide day-to-day partnership and guidance.
  • Data analysis: Review and analyze People metrics and analytics (including employee experience and lifecycle data) to spot trends and support informed decisions.
  • Employee engagement: Work with leaders to roll out engagement initiatives.
  • People programs support: Help develop and implement people programs that foster employee growth and development.
  • People team support: Be an active member of the People Experience team, contributing to strong HR capabilities.

About you:

  • You're a self-starter with strong communication and presentation skills.
  • You've got a knack for creative problem solving and avoid a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • You're a champion for change, supporting leaders and employees through change initiatives.
  • You care about employee engagement, team members' well-being, and DEIB, and are eager to help build programs that support them.
  • You understand the importance of tailoring programs, strategies, and suggestions to fit different needs.
  • You're agile and adaptable, with a growth mindset for learning new skills.

What we're looking for:

  • HR Experience: 5+ years of progressive HR/People experience, ideally as an HRBP or People Partner supporting multiple teams or functions. You bring real depth across organizational design, change management, performance management, DEIB, culture championing, coaching and development, and people programs such as rewards and recognition. A strong foundation in People data and analytics — using metrics to diagnose issues and drive decisions — is especially important for this role.
  • Business Acumen: Ability to understand performance objectives that drive business outcomes, and to leverage data and analytics to support informed business decisions.
  • Experience with Management: Experience partnering with leaders and demonstrating influence and accountability in support of the people agenda.
  • Global Perspective: Ability to establish trust, fairness, and credibility with team members, managers, and cross-functional partners in a global environment.
  • Collaborative Problem Solver: Ability to work seamlessly with key partners across the People Team, including Recruiting, People Operations, and Total Rewards.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. We are offering a compensation package between $100k - $130k USD, subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter
  2. 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager
  3. 45-minute video call with the Business Leader, Compensation Leader and 2 People Partner Team Members
  4. Take-Home Assignment + 60-minute Panel Presentation with the People Team Leadership

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Hello, I’m Steve, Director of Sales at Customer.io! We're expanding our sales team in the United States and seeking motivated and successful Account Executives at the Mid-Market level to join us! This role offers a unique opportunity to take your sales career to the next level, with potential for upward mobility.

As an Account Executive, you’ll represent Customer.io to prospective customers and drive growth within key market segments. This is a full-cycle sales role (prospect, demo, close), where you'll be fielding both inbound and outbound demand.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Responsibilities:

  • Pipeline Development and Management: Build and manage a pipeline through self-sourced leads and SDR-supported leads to drive new customer acquisition.
  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Lead the entire sales process from prospecting and discovery through demo and closing, focusing on new business acquisition within targeted accounts.
  • Customer Needs Analysis and Solution Alignment: Conduct discovery calls to understand customer business challenges and goals. Position Customer.io's solutions to meet these needs effectively.
  • Collaboration and Cross-Functional Feedback: Work closely with the SDR team for lead quality feedback and collaborate with Customer Success and Technical Support for a smooth hand-off post-sale.
  • Performance Tracking and Reporting: Own and report on individual sales metrics, including pipeline status and progress towards targets, to support informed decision-making.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B SaaS or MarTech sales, handling mid-market accounts
  • Location: We are currently hiring for positions based in the United States. Candidates must be located in one of these regions to be considered for the role.
  • B2B SaaS or MarTech Experience: Proven success in new customer acquisition and closing deals within the B2B SaaS space, preferably MarTech
  • Sales Methodology: Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar framework that supports consultative selling and discovery to close.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and engaging presence to build rapport with new prospects.
  • Problem Solving: Strong ability to identify customer business needs and position relevant solutions effectively to drive acquisition
  • Deal Focus: Primarily handles mid-market accounts with shorter sales cycles and lower ACV deals
  • Support: Works closely with our SDR team for lead generation, with a balance between inbound and self-sourced opportunities
  • Responsibilities:
    • Engage in high-volume prospecting, cold and warm outreach
    • Manage the full sales cycle for deals typically under $50,000 ACV
    • Drive growth within mid-sized clients, nurturing relationships and uncovering business needs

In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

jobs.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our Sales Strategy & Operations team and own how ElevenLabs goes to market by vertical. As we shift from a horizontal motion to a vertical-led one, you will go deep on each of our top verticals — the buyer, the use cases, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win — and turn that into a repeatable playbook for launching and scaling each one.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll sit at the center of the vertical GTM motion, working with Product Marketing, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales leadership to define each vertical's strategy, surface product gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment until every vertical is launched and performing. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a new market from the ground up, not maintain an existing one.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Vertical Deep Dives - Own the research and strategy for each top vertical: market sizing, ICP and persona definition, buying process, priority use cases, competitive positioning, and where ElevenLabs wins.

  • Vertical Launches - Run the end-to-end launch of each vertical, from strategy and segmentation through enablement, pipeline targets, and post-launch performance reviews.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment - Drive alignment across PMM, FDE, Product, Sales, and Marketing on vertical priorities, owners, and timelines. Be the single thread that keeps every function moving in the same direction.

  • Product Needs - Dig deep into what each vertical requires from the product — integrations, compliance, features, workflows, and translate field signal into prioritized, evidence-backed requirements for Product.

  • Data-Driven Strategy - Define the metrics that matter for each vertical (pipeline, win rate, ACV, sales cycle, product adoption), build the dashboards, and use the insights to decide where to double down or pull back.

  • Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and GTM leadership on where to invest by vertical, with clear recommendations and regular performance reporting.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

  • Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

  • Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations or GTM strategy, ideally with experience building or launching a vertical GTM motion

  • Proven track record of taking an ambiguous strategic question to a structured answer, then driving execution across teams.

  • Deep curiosity about industries — you enjoy learning how a healthcare, financial services, or retail buyer actually operates and what they need

  • Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Product, Marketing, and Sales leaders without direct authority.

  • Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and comfort operating in a fast-moving, undefined space.

  • Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

We're looking for someone to join our Revenue Strategy & Operations team to play a key role in building the operational backbone behind our partner ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence. You'll own the systems, automations, data, and dashboards that help our Partnerships team source, co-sell, and scale revenue through resellers, referral partners, technology partners, and strategic alliances.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member is a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function. In this role, you'll be the strategic and operational counterpart to Partnerships leadership. You'll also work closely with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Data, and Product to make partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue visible, measurable, and repeatable.

In this role, you will be responsible for

  • Partner Lifecycle & Process Management: Design, build, and maintain end-to-end processes for the partner journey, including onboarding, deal registration, lead and referral routing, co-sell workflows, and payout or commission handling. Make these processes consistent, automated, and easy to adopt.

  • Strategic Partnership to Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to Partnerships leadership, providing performance reporting, capacity and territory planning input, partner segmentation, and recommendations on program structure and incentives.

  • Partner Attribution & Pipeline Visibility: Define and maintain how we track partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and co-sell pipeline and revenue across Salesforce and our data stack. Make sure partner contribution is accurately attributed and trusted by Sales, Finance, and leadership.

  • Reporting & Analytics: Own dashboards, reports, and KPIs for partner performance, such as pipeline generation, win rates, sales cycle, partner ROI, and tier or segment health. Turn the data into insights that guide where we invest.

  • Partner Program & Incentive Operations: Support the design, modeling, and rollout of partner programs, including tiering, rebates, referral fees, and MDF. Work with Finance and Legal to ensure accuracy and compliance.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align Sales, Account Management, Marketing, Finance, and Product on how partner deals are handled, from account mapping and conflict resolution to handoffs and renewals.

  • Experimentation: Test new partner motions, lead sources, routing logic, and program levers. Measure what works and scale it.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You'll thrive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about audio AI, driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and to push the frontiers of new technology.

  • Are highly motivated, with a strong work ethic. We're at a critical moment in audio AI's evolution and committed to going the extra mile to lead.

  • Are analytical and efficient, and approach complex challenges with a first-principles mindset.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

  • Are energized by working with external partners and by the ambiguity of building a program that's still scaling.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, or Partner/Channel Operations at a high-growth technology company

  • Hands-on experience supporting partner, channel, alliance, or co-sell motions (e.g., deal registration, partner attribution, referral or reseller programs)

  • A proven track record of building end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis through execution

  • Strong Salesforce experience, including objects, reporting, and process design for partner-related workflows

  • Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g., Sigma)

  • The ability to break complex problems into smaller, actionable steps

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external partners

  • A highly adaptable, proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

  • Coachability and a willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • CPA

You'll support Engineering and Product leaders across our international teams, getting to know their rhythms, challenges, and talent needs.   • Partner with Engineering and Product leaders across our international teams to support team health, performance, and talent density.

  • Coach leads and managers through people challenges, including feedback, performance, conflict, growth conversations, and team change.

  • Run proactive 1:1 sessions mainly with leads, and with peeps where needed, surfacing issues early.

  • Contribute to organisational design work, advising on team structures, spans and layers, and capability gaps.

  • Support leaders and teams through change, such as team moves and new ways of working.

  • Support key People programs (performance reviews, engagement, recognition, and lead enablement) for Engineering and Product.

  • Work with Employee Relations and, where required, Legal Counsel on early-stage ER issues, escalating complex cases.

  • Spot patterns across teams and share them with the wider People team to shape new People initiatives.

  • Work with People Ops & Compliance teams to support terminations, mobility, and local requirements in each country where needed.

  • Experience supporting leaders and teams through people topics such as performance, coaching, growth, and team change.

  • Strong coaching skills, with the confidence to guide managers through difficult conversations.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion, clarity, and fairness.

  • Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, ambiguous environment and make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable with both partnership and hands-on execution when needed.

  • Comfortable working with leaders across different timezones and cultures; experience supporting globally distributed or multi-jurisdiction teams is a strong plus.

jobs.jobDescription:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical builds the open-source software that runs the world’s clouds, devices and AI, and we hold our managers to a high standard. Our Talent Development team exists to make leaders and managers at Canonical genuinely excellent. We define what great management looks like here, and we put that standard into the hands of managers and leaders across the company.

The Organisational Development Associate is where our most driven early-career people begin. From day one you work with real teams and take on real change, coached hard by senior practitioners on a fast path toward running this work yourself. This is not a support or back-office role, and it is not generalist HR. We hire for potential, drive and coachability over a polished CV, and we back the people we hire to move fast.

Applying to this role will enter you into our People Track for consideration across roles in the function.

Location: These are remote based positions, available across EMEA and the Americas.

The role entails

  • Being embedded inside a real team: see how it works day to day, and surface what is and isn't working.
  • Running the diagnostics on a team's health and management effectiveness (engagement, 360, direct feedback), and turning the evidence into a clear, honest read.
  • Owning an improvement end to end: a concrete change to how a team works that you design, drive and land, with a senior practitioner alongside you.
  • Supporting managers in delivering effective 360 performance feedback to individuals and helping them turn it into two or three real commitments they follow through on.
  • Helping build the playbook: the standards, tools and shared language the whole function runs on. You are building the system others use, not producing filler.
  • Learning coaching and organisational development directly from senior practitioners, on a fast, visible path to running this work yourself.

What we are looking for in you

  • A track record of leading and organising early. You have run things, built things, won people over and made change happen, in a startup, a student society, the military, a team, anywhere. People around you already see you as a driver.
  • A deliberate pull toward developing people and organisations. You chose this field on purpose, with a real grounding in organisational or industrial psychology, behavioural science or a comparable basis. It is not a fallback.
  • Drive and eagerness to learn. You have your own ideas and the confidence to challenge, and you are hungry to be coached and to grow fast.
  • The presence to sit across from experienced people and talk about change with confidence.
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.
  • Up to around two years of experience since graduating.
  • Business level written and spoken English.
  • Organised, accurate, confident, authentic, results-oriented, and enthusiastic.
  • Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

  • Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
  • Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
  • Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
  • Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Any exposure to people, organisational, coaching or consulting work, through study, an internship or a first job.
  • A genuine interest in the craft of management and organisations, not just the subject matter.
  • Comfort working with data.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of how we support our people through performance, conflict, and change is growing quickly. Our Employee Relations (ER) Partners protect fairness, consistency, and trust as we grow. You'll own our most sensitive and complex People cases, so that leads can act early.

As an ER Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll lead formal performance processes, investigations, grievances, and disciplinary matters from start to finish, working closely with Legal and outside counsel across many jurisdictions. You'll also coach leads through difficult conversations before they become formal cases, and turn what you see into playbooks, frameworks, and training that reduce risk and case volume over time.

This is our first ER hire. We're building a dedicated ER function, and we want someone who can help shape and build it out: how cases are triaged and escalated, how we work with counsel, and how we measure what's working.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can handle sensitive situations with discretion, make sound judgment calls, and bring clarity and calm to fast-moving environments.

You will

  • Lead formal performance processes, including back on track plans, end to end, in partnership with Leads and People Partners.

  • Run fair, well-documented investigations into misconduct allegations, grievances, and complaints, from fact-finding through to outcome.

  • Manage disciplinary, dismissal, and exit matters, drafting outcomes and communications with Legal.

  • Partner with in-house employment counsel and, when necessary, outside counsel to assess risk.

  • Triage incoming cases with People Partners using clear escalation criteria, so the right cases reach ER at the right time.

  • Keep the case log and report on patterns, risks, and trends by team, region, and case type.

  • Build playbooks, templates, and training that raise lead capability and cut avoidable cases.

  • Build out a self-serve ER flow for leads, so that common ER cases become scalable.

  • Partner with People Ops & Compliance teams to ensure smooth execution of terminations, local requirements, and compliance-heavy workflows.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience leading employee relations cases, including performance management, investigations, grievances, and disciplinaries, ideally in a fast-growing company.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion, clarity, and fairness.

  • Solid working knowledge of employment law principles and comfort working alongside in-house and outside counsel.

  • Skilled in writing clear, defensible documentation and coaching leads through hard conversations.

  • Comfortable moving fast and staying agile, shifting priorities quickly as cases and the business change, without losing rigour.

  • Comfortable building process as well as running cases, as the ER function is still being built.

  • Experience supporting globally distributed teams or multi-jurisdiction environments is a strong plus.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in on the East Coast USA or Europe.

We are hiring an Observability Engineering Manager who will lead the development of the distributed tracing or service mesh products as part of our Observability group.

Engineering managers at Canonical are always coders who are able to review and lead both architecture and code. They should also be astute judges of character, and comfortable setting expectations and holding colleagues accountable to them.

We are excited to be improving the state of the art for open-source observability.

This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Kubernetes, and Observability. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

We are seeking a strategic, process-driven Director of Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) with a strong focus on operations planning, resource management, and labor modeling. This role owns the integrated planning function responsible for translating business strategy into executable operational plans that balance capacity and labor against service and cost targets. This is a highly visible leadership role, setting the operations planning strategy and partnering directly with senior leadership across the organization to shape network-wide decisions. Additionally this role will be responsible for evolving the department - partnering with cross functional teams to create newer and more accurate models that leverage industry best practices and expertise.

You Will:

  • Own the Operations Planning Strategy: Set the vision and governance for the S&OP process, chairing the weekly S&OP meeting and driving alignment between demand signals and executable operations plans across the network.

    • Define the KPI framework and accountability structure that governs plan execution across sites and functions.

  • Fulfillment Capacity Strategy: Own medium- to long-range capacity planning across the network, setting the strategy for personnel, equipment, and material capabilities, and making the call on when network routing or footprint changes are needed.

  • Labor & Resource Planning Leadership:

    • Own the translation of volume plans into required hours by role and process path, and the labor models that drive it.

    • Serve as the primary executive partner to HR, Finance, and Operations leadership in aligning staffing strategy with operational demand across the network.

    • Develop and recommend the long-range workforce strategy by anticipating volume trends, seasonal spikes, and the labor impact of strategic initiatives.

    • Provide recommendations on cross-training, temporary staffing, and overtime strategy based on network-wide capacity constraints.

  • Operational Scenario Modeling: Direct scenario planning to simulate the impact of volume changes, labor availability, or supply disruptions, and translate the results into leadership recommendations and contingency plans.

  • Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment: Serve as the primary point of accountability across compounding, dispense and fulfillment, planning, and finance to ensure operational readiness, resolving cross-functional trade-offs and escalations.

  • Process Optimization: Set the roadmap for continuous improvement in planning processes and models, driving initiatives that improve modeling accuracy, increase efficiency or increase visibility.

  • Performance Management & Reporting: Own the dashboard and KPI strategy for plan adherence, resource utilization, labor efficiency, and production performance, and use it to drive decisions at the leadership level.

  • Executive Communication & Influence: Present operational insights and capacity trade-offs to executive leadership as needed, shaping strategic decisions on network investment, staffing, and capacity.

  • Team Leadership & Development: Build, lead, and develop a team of planners and analysts, establishing career paths and elevating planning capability across the organization.

You Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Supply Chain, or related field (MBA or Master's preferred).

  • 12+ years of experience in operations planning, resource management, or labor modeling in a manufacturing, warehouse, or industrial setting.

  • 8+ years of people leadership experience, including managing teams larger than 6.

  • Proven track record setting operations planning strategy at a multi-site or network level.

  • Expertise in workforce planning, labor forecasting, and operational planning, with deep fluency in translating data into executive-level strategy.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with advanced skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or labor planning software.

  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with a demonstrated track record of influencing C-suite/senior leadership decisions.

  • Experience leading the implementation or selection of labor planning tools or workforce management systems at scale.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is a global technology company that builds infrastructure for online commerce with a mission to increase the GDP of the internet. Through Bridge, Stripe is building stablecoin infrastructure that helps businesses move, store, and use money globally. This role will support Bridge as it develops and scales products for companies operating across markets.

What you’ll do

Stripe is looking for an exceptional transactional lawyer to join our commercial legal team supporting Bridge and Stripe’s fast-growing stablecoin business.

Responsibilities

  • Support Bridge’s commercial team, leading negotiations for complex and strategic user and partner agreements.
  • Advise on commercial and legal issues arising from stablecoin products, new product launches, and international expansion.
  • Work closely with Product Legal and Bridge’s product and engineering teams to bring new products and features to market.
  • Help build Bridge’s commercial legal infrastructure so the business can scale efficiently, including drafting and maintaining agreements and playbooks, improving internal processes, and using AI tooling to optimize how we work with clients, partners, and users.
  • Partner with teams across Bridge and Stripe globally, including commercial, operations, product, engineering, tax, compliance, and risk.
  • Help the team provide practical, scalable legal support while working collaboratively across a global Commercial Legal team.
  • Develop and deliver training and resources to help Bridge’s commercial team sell and support its products.
  • Be a point of escalation for outside counsel.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Intellectually curious and a creative problem solver - Bridge’s products and the stablecoin industry are complex and fast evolving - you should relish learning new products and finding practical solutions to challenging problems.
  • A self-starter with a bias for action - you are proactive and have a strong sense of ownership.
  • A clear and concise communicator (in written and verbal forms), who can distill the key risks and explain complex, nuanced issues in plain and simple terms.
  • A natural collaborator, able to guide cross-functional teams and drive to a win-win solution.
  • Familiar with the legal issues and commercial risks arising from fintech, stablecoin, hosted data, and technology services.
  • A team player who is willing to do what it takes to contribute to the collective success.
  • Qualified with good standing membership in at least one US state bar with a JD degree or foreign equivalent.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in-house or in a technology practice group in a top law firm.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working in payments, fintech, crypto, or stablecoin businesses and knowledge of associated regulatory issues.
  • In-house experience advising high-growth companies.
  • Working knowledge of LLM tools.
  • Experience in improving legal processes with AI technology.
  • A working knowledge of data protection laws such as CCPA, GDPR, and HIPAA.

jobs.jobDescription:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled and business-savvy IP and Commercial Counsel to support the ongoing operations of StackAdapt’s AI-Powered Marketing Orchestration Platform and its expanding suite of programmatic and owned-channel products, including connected TV (CTV), digital out-of-home, display, audio, and email. This Counsel will work closely with product managers, engineers, data science, compliance, privacy, and commercial teams to provide legal guidance on the design, implementation, and commercialization of advertising technologies, AI-driven and automated features, and data solutions, as well as being responsible for the Company’s intellectual property portfolio and complex intellectual property litigation. StackAdapt embraces AI and automation across the business, and this Counsel is expected to use those tools to work efficiently and to extend the reach and efficacy of the legal team.

StackAdapt is a remote first company. This role is open to applicants currently located in Canada or the United States.

What you'll do

Commercial & Platform Agreements

  • Draft, negotiate, and interpret contracts with clients and ad tech ecosystem partners, including Supply Path Optimization (SPO) agreements with SSPs, publishers, and ad exchanges, as well as data sharing and measurement/verification vendor agreements.
  • Manage and negotiate IAB terms and conditions, specifically including the Standard Terms and Conditions (2.0-4.0) and the Multi-State Privacy Agreement.
  • Review and negotiate agreements for AI and automation vendors, covering model and data licensing, generative-AI tools, and terms governing the use of company or third-party training data.
  • Develop automated and AI-assisted workflows to ensure internal compliance with all ecosystem partner agreements.

Intellectual Property & Litigation

  • Partner with and manage external counsel globally across all IP litigation, strategy, and regulatory matters.
  • Direct all phases of complex IP and patent litigation, from strategy development and enforcement actions (e.g., preparing claim charts) to court appearances, drafting settlement agreements, and negotiating IP licenses.
  • Advise management on overall IP strategy by overseeing patentability, freedom-to-operate, and infringement analyses.
  • Work with internal R&D and product teams to identify patentable inventions, guide portfolio development, and provide training on IP best practices.
  • Oversee IP due diligence for acquisitions, divestitures, or partnerships.
  • Monitor changes in patent law and the evolving AI regulatory landscape to proactively advise on potential impacts to the company.

Product Counselling

  • Provide comprehensive legal, IP, and regulatory guidance to internal teams during the design and launch of programmatic, martech, and owned-channel features, specifically including targeting, bidding algorithms, and data integrations.
  • Advise on the legal and compliance implications of AI, machine learning, and automated decision-making tools, including training data, model outputs, and emerging governance obligations.
  • Support the Privacy team on data governance matters involving bid-stream, impression, user-volunteered, and third-party data.
  • Guide post-launch compliance efforts, including auditing mechanisms and the ongoing protection of proprietary technology via trademarks, copyrights, and patents.

What you Bring

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and Call to the Bar in one or more Canadian Provinces or one or more US states, with active license to practice law in such jurisdiction(s)
  • 6+ years of legal experience, preferably in technology, with at least 3 years in an in-house commercial role and 3 years of complex litigation experience.
  • Strong aptitude for complex technology and desire to learn the functioning of the ad tech ecosystem (including DSPs, SSPs, ad exchanges, CTV and other emerging channels, AI-powered ad tech, and programmatic advertising principles.)
  • Excellent negotiation, analytical, and communication skills to manage disputes and advise senior leadership.
  • Ability to handle complex cases and meet litigation deadlines in a high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving to balance legal risks with business goals.
  • Strong drafting and negotiation skills for commercial agreements.
  • Ability to simplify complex legal and technical concepts for cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with non-legal stakeholders, including product managers and engineers.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment and provide clear, actionable legal advice.
  • A demonstrated appetite for adopting automation and AI tools to drive efficiency and consistency in legal workflows.

jobs.jobDescription:
Nash is the autonomic logistics platform. Self-optimizing, self-healing AI Agents unify decisioning and execution across fleets, carriers, and fulfillment networks. Set the objective, and the system runs until you hit it. We’re 1,000+ customers across 20+ countries, backed by a16z and Y Combinator.

About this role

Nash is hiring its first global field and event marketing lead. You will own how Nash shows up in person: the event strategy for the company, and the field execution behind it in every region. You will build the event calendar with our regional GTM leads, and lead a team of regional field managers across APAC, EMEA and North America. You report to the VP of Growth and work directly with Sales leaders in each region.

What you own

  • The event calendar. You decide which shows and sponsorships earn a place, and how big Nash goes at each one.

  • The account list for each event, shared with Sales, so events and outreach point the same way.

  • What each event returned, and what that says about where Nash shows up next.

  • The field budget across regions, invested against pipeline and deal acceleration.

  • Every in-person moment Nash creates: booths, dinners, hosted events, gifting, merch and swag.

  • ABM events for our top accounts, built with the account teams. Executive dinners, onsites, and gifts made for one account at a time.

  • The relationships with show organizers, partners and vendors that earn speaking slots, better booth placement, and co-hosted events.

  • Vendors and production partners in every region. You choose them, set the terms, and hold them to the standard, across booth build, print, swag, freight and storage.

  • The content each event produces. You shoot your own, direct photographers and videographers, and get attendees and the team posting.

  • Internal events, including all-hands and company offsites, held to the same standard as the ones customers see.

  • The regional team. You hire the field managers, set the standard, and keep running the events that matter most yourself.

What you bring

  • 7+ years in B2B field or event marketing, across more than one region.

  • Shows you owned outright. You picked them, ran them, and answered for what came back.

  • You have run an event people wanted to come to and talked about afterward. One you were proud of, and that became a flagship part of the company.

  • A team you built and led across time zones, employees or contractors, including the hiring.

  • Super self-starter. You find the person who can unblock you, and you can put something good together on budget and with days' notice, then build the system that makes the next one easier to run.

  • Taste and polish. You know the difference between a booth people stop at and one they walk past, and the details guests notice are right, from the invite through the run of show.

  • Pipeline and the big picture. You can walk through the pipeline your events produced and how it moved, and you plan a year of events as one program rather than a series of one-offs.

  • AI already in your workflow, and something you built or improved that you can show us.

  • Command of budget and logistics at scale, and steadiness in the week of a show.

  • Willingness to travel 30 to 40% of the year.

How to Apply

Send us your resume, links or photos of events you have run, and a short note on the one you are proudest of and why. If you would rather skip the cover letter and send a Loom walking us through that event, the invite that filled the room, or the run of show behind it, that is very much encouraged.

Want to grab our attention and bypass the Recruiting platform? Record a video introducing yourself at testimonials.nash.ai with code JOIN-NASH. Your application pings us in Slack the moment it lands. If you are show ready at 8am on the first morning of a conference, this is nothing.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.jobDescription:
About Dojo

Dojo started as a simple way for teachers to show parents what happened in class. Today it's used in 95% of US K-8 schools and by 1 in 4 American families, and reaches about 50 million kids in 180 countries. We got here with around 220 people and have never paid for a user.

Families trust us with their kids, and we're now building on that trust. On Dojo Islands, kids explore a shared world with their friends after school. Dojo Tutor connects families with tutors. Sparks is an AI tutor for every kid, and Login with Dojo will let children sign in safely anywhere online.

Our mission is to give every child on Earth an education they love. We hire for talent density, and many of our people came from Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber and Y Combinator.

The job

Every product above lives in a category whose rules haven't been written yet. State legislatures, the FTC and the EU are writing them right now. What should a shared online world for eight-year-olds allow? How should an AI talk to a child? Who verifies a kid's identity, and what happens to that data? Some company will answer these questions well, in public, and earn the trust of parents and schools for a generation. We want that company to be Dojo, and we want you to lead it.

As Head of Legal you'll sit on the leadership team and work directly with our co-founders. You'll own all of legal: product, privacy, commercial, corporate, employment, IP, regulatory and litigation. You'll inherit good foundations, including a small in-house team, trusted outside counsel and working commercial and privacy processes. Your job is to make them great.

We have strong views on how this should work. Trust is our moat, and the right Head of Legal makes it deeper every quarter while teams ship faster. The best legal answer is usually a version of yes with sensible guardrails, reached early, before anyone has spent months building the wrong thing. We also think AI now lets a small team of exceptional lawyers do what used to take fifteen. You'll get to prove it.

Your first 18 months

Make Dojo the company parents trust most with their kids.

  • Decide where Dojo stands on the hardest questions in kids' tech, and say it publicly before regulators decide for us: AI that talks to children, kids playing together online, and how products for kids should make money.

  • Figure out which seals and certifications actually change a parent's or a district's mind, then win them.

  • Make privacy one of the reasons districts pick Dojo.

  • When a regulator calls, handle it so well that the product and our reputation come out unharmed.

Make legal the reason things ship faster.

  • Get pulled into the room early by product, engineering and partnerships, because you make their plans better. Find the version that can ship, name the one or two real showstoppers, and tell the team what to do this week.

  • Turn standard contracts in hours and product questions in two days.

  • Write the playbooks that let district data agreements, partnerships and vendor deals close without starting from zero each time.

Build a legal team that outperforms teams five times its size.

  • Lead and grow a small, very good in-house team, and hold outside counsel to budget and to your standard.

  • Put AI into the daily work on contracts, data agreements and privacy reviews. Decide what comes in-house and what stays with specialists, so outside spend falls while quality rises.

  • Own M&A, financing and board matters with our CFO, and keep the company ready to do a deal or a raise on short notice.

You will be a match if:

  • You've led legal at a consumer tech company of 100 to 1,000 people, where product and engineering create most of the value.

  • Product and business leaders who've worked with you say, unprompted, that you made them faster and found answers they hadn't seen. You end your advice with what you'd do, and once the call is made you own it.

  • You've owned privacy for a consumer product, ideally one for kids, across COPPA, FERPA, state student privacy laws, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR and the new rules on AI. If your depth is narrower, you learn fast and already think about it clearly.

  • You're comfortable running M&A, financings and board work alongside a CFO.

  • You've led talent-dense teams and managed several outside firms to budget. You know the right specialist for almost any problem and can get them on the phone today.

  • You've rebuilt legal work with AI yourself, and can explain concretely how three lawyers plus specialists can match fifteen.

  • You turn a messy problem into the two or three decisions that matter, and you write short. You hold a position without starting a war, and you change your mind when the facts change, and you move decisions on trust rather than title.

  • You move fast enough to make people slightly nervous, and you raise the bar on ambition as much as on rigor.

Bonus:

  • 10+ years in law, ideally including child-directed products or student data.

  • Time spent in strategy consulting, operating, finance or engineering.

  • You've stepped into an existing legal function and made it markedly better, or led a distributed team.

  • You can tell Dojo's story to a regulator, a reporter or a partner and leave them on our side.

You won't match every line here. If these problems make you want to start tomorrow, apply anyway. Some of our best people took unusual paths to get here.

Why now

Very few legal jobs let you shape how a generation of kids experiences the internet. The questions are new, the stakes are real, and the answers you reach here will set norms far beyond Dojo. You'll have the scale to matter, a team small enough that your judgment shows up in everything, and founders who want a real partner on the hardest calls.

[1] Some more context:

(If you are on LinkedIn, you will not be able to access the hyperlinks below. Once you click apply, you will be directed to our career website (if you are not on there already) and will be able to access the hyperlinks)

  • How ClassDojo Connects Parents, Students, and Teachers

  • “Whats New on ClassDojo 2023”

  • TechCrunch Article: Second Act comes with First Profits

Click here if you're interested in learning more about what we've been up to.
