jobs.jobDescription:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (U.S.)
Role Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Director, Early Talent, Claude Corps
Manages: Claude Corps screeners
Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000

About Claude Corps

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Each cohort is larger than the last, and every candidate deserves a process that feels organized, responsive, and human. That’s where you come in.

You’ll lead the Claude Corps screener team day to day. You make sure applications are reviewed, screens are completed, and every candidate decision is documented on time.

The Director sets recruiting strategy and cohort hiring goals. You turn those goals into weekly targets, plan staffing, and manage the team’s work. This is a hands-on management role. You train and coach screeners, review their work, and keep selection standards consistent as volume grows. You work closely with the Director, the recruiting coordinator, and the Claude Corps program team.

Key Activities

Run screening delivery

  • Turn cohort hiring goals into weekly review and screening targets with the Director
  • Assign work based on volume, deadlines, and screener availability
  • Track outstanding reviews, screens, and decisions, and flag staffing gaps early
  • Deliver a steady pipeline of qualified candidates to final-round interviews

Maintain clear selection standards

  • Train screeners on the program’s eligibility requirements, interview questions, and evaluation criteria
  • Make sure every decision has a completed scorecard with clear evidence
  • Review decisions regularly for consistency across screeners, and resolve unclear guidance
  • Use candidate and final-round results to sharpen screening guidance and questions

Build and lead the screener team

  • Hire and train screeners as cohort needs grow
  • Set clear expectations for output, decision quality, documentation, and candidate communication
  • Coach screeners with regular feedback and address performance issues directly
  • Run weekly team meetings and keep the screener guide and process instructions current

Run the operation

  • Keep Greenhouse reviews, stages, and scorecards complete and accurate
  • Give the Director weekly results, explain what’s driving changes, and recommend actions
  • Plan screening capacity ahead of application surges and share what results show about where more qualified applicants are needed
  • Use AI and automation to cut repetitive administrative work, and train screeners to check the quality of what it produces
  • Keep people responsible for evaluating candidates and making selection decisions

Key Success Metrics

  • Weekly delivery: Application reviews and screens meet agreed targets, and delays and staffing gaps are flagged early
  • Selection quality: Screeners apply criteria consistently, with clear evidence in every scorecard
  • Screener readiness: New screeners are trained in time for cohort needs and meet the team’s standards
  • Accurate reporting: The Director gets reliable weekly numbers with context and recommended actions
  • Team performance: Screeners get regular feedback, and performance issues are addressed promptly

Qualifications

  • You have at least five (5) years of recruiting experience, including managing recruiters or screeners in a high-volume or early-talent hiring program
  • You have managed a team’s workload, output, and quality using weekly targets and reporting
  • You have trained people to apply consistent selection standards and can explain how you checked their decisions
  • You have coached team members and addressed performance issues directly
  • You have personally reviewed applications and conducted structured candidate screens at volume
  • You can manage candidate stages, scorecards, and reports in an applicant tracking system (Greenhouse experience is preferred)
  • You use AI in your work and can describe a process you improved or automated
  • You can build clear processes while a program is still developing and adjust them as needed

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$110,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding)

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.
    • Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
    • Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
    • Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.
  • RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.
    • Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
    • Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.
  • Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.
    • Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
    • Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
    • Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
    • Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)
  • Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.
    • e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
  • Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
  • Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$164,000—$240,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.jobDescription:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About the role

Sr. Director | Reports to the CMO | Leads a team of 4 | Global scope across the Americas, EMEA, and APJ | Location: US

You will lead the team that sets marketing's pipeline targets with Sales, measures what drives revenue, runs campaign operations, and builds the AI agents our marketers use every day. You will bring a point of view to the marketing leadership team on where we invest.

Why this role

  • Own the pipeline number with Sales. You will set marketing's pipeline targets by region, segment, and channel, and measure progress against them.
  • Build an AI-run marketing team on Dataiku. You will design and govern the agents our marketers rely on, and your work becomes a story we tell customers.
  • Shape where the money goes. Your analysis guides marketing investment decisions and reaches the CMO and the board.
  • High leverage, global reach. A team of four covering three regions, with a mandate to grow capacity through automation and AI rather than headcount.

What you will do

Set and measure the number

  • Build the funnel model that works back from bookings and ARR targets to pipeline, engagement, and coverage targets, agreed with Sales.
  • Launch a new account-based attribution model and make it the one Sales uses in pipeline reviews.
  • Own the marketing performance scorecard: one source of truth, shared with Sales, from brand awareness through account engagement to pipeline.
  • Measure the return on every program and event, so we fund what works and cut what doesn't.

Run the marketing engine

  • Lead campaign operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, with clear intake, quality, and turnaround standards for global and regional teams.
  • Own the marketing technology stack, roadmap, and budget, and simplify it.
  • Build account scoring, segmentation, and routing that match how Sales covers accounts.
  • Set the lifecycle, campaign naming, and data standards that make reporting trustworthy.

Build the AI layer

  • Build and govern Marketing's AI agents and GenAI workflows on Dataiku, from first idea through evaluation, review, and monitoring.
  • Get every marketer using these tools in their weekly work, and report the productivity gains.
  • Use automation and agents to grow the team's output without growing its size.

Guide investment

  • Provide the spend and performance data behind marketing's planning and budget decisions.
  • Run experiments and recommend where to move budget each quarter, by channel, region, and program.
  • Make performance data self-service, so marketers can answer their own questions.
  • Own data quality, privacy and consent compliance (including GDPR), and responsible AI use across marketing.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in marketing operations, analytics, or revenue operations at an enterprise B2B software company, including 4+ years leading teams.
  • An attribution model you shipped that Sales trusted and used.
  • Account-based measurement built with Sales, including target account engagement and buying-group progression.
  • A hands-on background (attribution, and AI agents or GenAI workflows in production) and the experience to now lead through a team, staying close enough to the work to unblock it.
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, 6sense, Clay, Gong, Snowflake, or similar tools. Dataiku experience is a plus.
  • Experience working across regions with different levels of data and process maturity.

How you work

  • You think like a business leader. You use data to shape strategy and investment, and you bring a point of view.
  • You treat pipeline as a number shared with Sales, and you agree on definitions before you build dashboards.
  • You influence senior stakeholders with data. You challenge plans the numbers don't support and defend the ones they do.
  • You are credible with engineers and with regional marketers.
  • You see governance as what lets a team move fast safely.

#LI-CM

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. jobs.jobDescription:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

About the Role

Build Brain Co.'s insurance business, from the first buyer conversation to a signed engagement. You'll originate opportunities and lead consultative sales through close, working with the GM of Insurance, product, engineering and deployment teams.

Our priority markets are property & casualty & life & annuities and the workflows span complex underwriting, claims, distribution and core operational processes where agentic orchestration of people and data can dramatically improve speed, quality and business outcomes.

Why Brain Co.

You'll help build the insurance business alongside the people developing and deploying the products. Your judgment will help determine which opportunities we pursue, how we win them and which recurring customer needs should shape the product.

Brain Co. builds AI systems that help large, regulated institutions carry out complex work. Our mission is to rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

What you'll own

  • Create demand. Help shape our pitch and narrative, open doors and build a pipeline through targeted outreach, executive and industry relationships, partners, conferences and events. Choose the right accounts, earn substantive meetings and turn follow-up into sales-qualified opportunities.

  • Discover and qualify. Convert marketing-generated and self-sourced leads into sales-qualified opportunities. Test the problem, economics, buyer, funding path and timing; know when to pursue, nurture or decline. Bring technical partners in early on data, security and implementation constraints.

  • Build the value case. Establish the customer's baseline and agree what improvement matters. Build clear briefs and proposals, partner with product and deployment on tailored demonstrations, and test the economic assumptions.

  • Lead the deal through close. Coordinate buyer and internal teams through scoping, pricing, security and legal review, procurement and negotiation. Validate commitments with product and deployment owners, then carry agreed scope, success measures and assumptions into a clear delivery handoff.

  • Inform what gets built. Distill recurring prospect needs, buying signals, objections and product gaps into recommendations for product strategy and roadmap priorities.

  • Build a repeatable sales motion. Keep account plans and forecasts accurate, learn from wins and losses, and create materials and practices that improve the next pursuit.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of relevant experience. You bring experience in enterprise sales, business development or management consulting, with direct accountability for originating opportunities and independently driving complex commercial engagements through close.

  • Complex multimillion-dollar closes. You've personally sold and closed custom technology deployments or tailored technology engagements, shaping bespoke solution scope, navigating implementation tradeoffs, building a quantified value case, negotiating contracts and aligning delivery commitments.

  • Insurance sales and domain depth. You've sold into insurance and can speak credibly about the industry's operating models, workflows and buying processes. You bring deep expertise in at least one of our priority markets: property & casualty, life & annuities, or specialty insurance.

  • Practical AI and technical fluency. You use AI in your own work, verify its outputs and can discuss data, integrations, evaluation and human oversight with buyers and technical partners.

  • Commercial judgment and execution. You create access, write clearly, put compelling materials together and keep several pursuits moving. You lead across teams without formal authority and do the detailed work yourself.

Bonus Points for

  • Experience selling AI products. You've won business for AI products or solutions and understand how customers evaluate, buy and deploy them.

  • Entrepreneurship. Experience building commercial motion and trusted relationships in a 0-to-1 startup environment.

Location and Travel

San Francisco, New York or remote on the East Coast preferred.

About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.

Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About This Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Web3 Business Development to join our team. You will be responsible for driving revenue growth by building relationships, expanding CertiK’s brand recognition, and closing revenue producing deals within specific channels in the Web3 space.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Web3 Task Force Team to create stronger connections to the blockchain ecosystem.

  • Building a verifiable pipeline of qualified leads and consistently closing deals

  • Building brand recognition and fostering relationships within specific channels across the Web3 landscape.

  • Provide input on product development with insights from customer experiences and market trends.

  • Assist with sales and BD efforts including: Participating in direct sales, building strategic partner relationships, creating sales materials, and summarizing sales learnings for the team

  • Perform tasks cross-functionally among the various teams at CertiK.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in the Web3 BD space.

  • Collaborative and team-oriented approach to securing new revenues and improving internal efficiencies.

  • Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it is going

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Influencer content is one of the highest-performing creative sources across our Meta and TikTok conversion programs, and we're investing further in it. We're hiring a Paid Media Influencer Analyst to sit at the intersection of our Influencer and Paid Media teams — sourcing, editing, launching, and measuring influencer-driven ads across multiple hims & hers product categories.

You'll work hand-in-hand with our influencer/creator team to help shape content that's built to convert, then take that content live through Meta Partnership Ads (allowlisting) and TikTok Spark Ads, and manage it like any other high-performing ad in the account. This role is ideal for someone who loves creator content but also wants to own the performance side — testing, optimizing, and scaling what works.

You Will:

  • Partner with the Influencer/Creator team to source and vet creators whose content and audience fit Hims & Hers paid media conversion goals across all product categories.

  • Write and guide all paid media influencer briefs and edits to ensure influencer content is optimized for conversion-focused paid ads, not just organic engagement.

  • Set up and launch influencer ads via Meta Partnership Ads (branded content allowlisting) and TikTok Spark Ads, ensuring proper permissions, tagging, and boosting are in place.

  • Manage and optimize live influencer ad campaigns, budget pacing, audience testing, and creative refresh to hit conversion and efficiency targets across categories.

  • Measure and report on influencer ad performance separately from and alongside brand/creative-led paid social, surfacing which influencers, formats, and hooks are driving results.

  • Build a repeatable system for tracking creator relationships, whitelisting status, content rights, and performance history.

  • Apply paid media amplification best practices to influencer content, including format, cropping, captions, and CTA placement by platform.

  • Feed performance learnings back to the Influencer team to inform which creators and content styles to prioritize for future partnerships.

  • Partner with Legal and Medical to ensure influencer content and disclosures meet healthcare marketing compliance requirements.

You Have:

  • Experience working directly with an influencer team, guiding content creation and editing toward conversion-focused paid outcomes (not just organic reach).

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Partnership Ads/branded content tools (allowlisting), including permissions setup and troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience running TikTok Spark Ads off creator organic posts.

  • Working knowledge of paid media amplification best practices for influencer and creator content across Meta and TikTok.

  • Experience in ecommerce or direct-to-consumer paid social, with the analytical skills to manage budget, measure performance, and optimize toward efficiency targets.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — you can work fluidly between creative/influencer partners and performance media teams.

  • Comfort with lightweight content editing/review to keep creator content on-brand and platform-ready ahead of launch.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in telehealth, healthcare, wellness, or another regulated or highly-compliant advertising category.

  • Familiarity with influencer/creator management platforms (e.g., Grin, Aspire, CreatorIQ).

  • Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) to guide or make quick creative tweaks.

  • Experience testing and scaling UGC or creator content beyond influencer-specific programs.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.

To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The administrative business partner (ABP) team works with Stripe's executive leaders to strategically manage their day-to-day administrative and operational needs, while also contributing significantly to projects and initiatives that help drive the company's strategic priorities

What you’ll do

This coverage ABP role is focused on covering critical gaps in administrative support to Stripe’s most senior leaders and requires someone who is flexible, agile, and eager to learn. You will be required to support multiple leaders on a temporary basis. You will have the unique opportunity to learn the ins and outs of different areas of the business, build relationships with various leaders, and contribute to the overall health of the global ABP team.

Responsibilities

  • Provide temporary administrative support to Stripe’s most senior leaders to uphold business continuity and core support
  • Provide complex and proactive calendar support for multiple leaders concurrently
  • Make recommendations to leaders with regard to their time management, prioritization, delegation, and organization
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel and manage all related details
  • Prepare and submit expense reports on behalf of leaders
  • Own programmatic work that supports the global ABP program
  • Assist with ad hoc projects for the ABP coverage program

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of administrative experience at a quickly scaling or large company, plus experience in a high-growth technology startup
  • You are incredibly organized, with superb attention to detail and a strong ability to execute. You are excellent with time management and able to quickly shift tasks and priorities as needed.
  • You have a knack for working across various roles and teams in a fast-paced, changing environment while remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient. You communicate, perform, and react well under pressure or ambiguity.
  • You enjoy optimizing processes to make them more efficient.
  • You are adept at handling sensitive information and situations with care and confidence. You are able to anticipate and respond to the needs of others before those needs arise.

jobs.jobDescription:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

What We're Looking For:

An Automation Engineer with a focus on Agentic Orchestration focuses on seamlessly connecting AI capabilities, including orchestrated agent systems, with existing business processes and enterprise applications. This role will leverage modern AI tools and frameworks to build sophisticated automation solutions and create and configure AI agents to handle complex, non-repetitive tasks that require reasoning, context-awareness, and interaction with multiple systems. Our ultimate goal is to design and deploy autonomous agentic systems that can independently manage and execute complex business processes with a high degree of accuracy and efficiency.

What you'll be doing:

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to conduct in-depth analysis of existing workflows, identifying and documenting opportunities for intelligent, AI-driven automation.
  • Oversee the entire lifecycle of AI agent development, from initial design and prototyping to testing, deployment, configuration, and lifecycle of AI solutions in production.
  • Ensure AI agent development security, scalability, and reliability through ongoing monitoring and performance tuning.
  • Design and implement integration solutions to connect AI agents and models with enterprise systems such as CRMs, ERPs, and internal databases.
  • Design and implement an evaluation system that serves as a mechanism for quality control and continuous improvement.
  • Build and configure AI agents to perform tasks such as natural language understanding, data extraction, decision-making, and system interactions.
  • Develop custom connectors, APIs, and middleware to facilitate data exchange and process automation between AI services and other applications.
  • Continuously explore and evaluate new AI technologies and tools to drive innovation in automation.
  • Mentor system admins and junior developers to build and configure AI Agents.

What you’ll bring to the table:

  • Demonstrable experience with AI services from major cloud providers (e.g., OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock) and hands-on experience with LLM APIs.
  • A solid understanding of business process analysis and re-engineering.
  • Solid understanding of Natural Language Processing (NLP), LLMs, and ML principles.
  • Experience with enterprise integration platforms (e.g., Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi).Experience with RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) is a plus, but the focus is on modern AI-driven automation.
  • Hands-on experience with conversational AI platforms and frameworks for building chatbots and virtual assistants.
  • Proficiency in Python and its associated AI/ML libraries (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pandas, TensorFlow, or PyTorch).
  • A solid understanding of embedding processes, vector databases, RAG systems and knowledge graphs.
  • Strong understanding of API design principles (REST, RPC, SSE, GraphQL) and data formats (JSON, XML).
  • Familiarity with database technologies (SQL and NoSQL).A creative and analytical mindset with passion for solving complex problems through automation.
  • Entrepreneurial approach, strong builder with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.jobDescription:
ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

What you’ll do:

ClassDojo is looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial, and high-energy leader to oversee and scale all aspects of the Company’s accounting and tax operations and strategy, with an opportunity to own additional related areas such as procurement.

In this role, you will build and scale financial systems, processes, and policies to support the financial health and efficient scaling of our entire business. You will oversee the company’s monthly close process, annual audits, financial reporting, and overall control processes, with the goal of generating utmost confidence in the quality of our financial reports and processes both internally and externally, across team members, the Board of Directors, third-party partners, regulators, and prospective investors.

You will oversee our in-house accounting team and external consultants in managing the accounting function, including GL, AP, technical / revenue accounting, financial reporting, payroll, equity, tax, and treasury. You will partner with a range of stakeholders across the organization, including but not limited to leaders across our various business units as well as functional leaders across Strategic Finance, People, Engineering, Legal, and other teams. You will support the CFO and other executives across a range of strategic initiatives, including M&A, fundraising, secondary transactions, and potentially a future IPO. This role will report directly to the CFO.

You will be a match if:

  • Experiences

    • You have 12+ years of experience, with 3+ years at a top-tier audit firm and 8+ years in-house accounting at fast-growing startups, with diverse and increasing levels of responsibility culminating in a controller or assistant controller role

    • You have built and retained an accounting team of meaningful scale and complexity, including both managers and individual contributors

    • You have designed and managed full-cycle accounting close and operations, and managed related areas including tax, treasury, payroll, and equity administration

    • You have led accounting teams through multiple clean audits with Big Four firms

    • You have applied your knowledge of US GAAP to complex business transactions, successfully documenting clear conclusions, establishing practical business processes, and defending accounting positions directly to external auditors

    • You have a proven track record of scaling finance operations through major process or systems overhauls, including experience incorporating AI-powered workflows

    • You have overseen global indirect tax compliance, including US sales tax and international VAT/GST

  • Attributes

    • Leadership - Proven record of finding and nurturing high potential talent and instilling a sense of integrity and ownership

    • Cross-functional effectiveness - Demonstrated ability to implement financial systems and processes with meaningful cross functional impact to support growth in volume and complexity of the business

    • Technical accounting acumen - Subject matter expertise in key US GAAP standards (including ASC 606, ASC 718, ASC 805, and ASC 350), with the ability to independently identify complex issues early in the transaction lifecycle

    • Strategic mindset - Deep curiosity for the company’s products and business strategy, and how these could impact accounting decisions. Ability to articulate these decisions effectively in communications with external partners and internal leaders

    • Scrappiness - Tendency to prioritize rigorously and preference for quality over volume. Demonstrated growth-mindset and willingness to own additional areas of responsibility as needed

Bonus:

  • Experience in a lead-level accounting role at a public tech company

  • Experience with emerging AI-native finance tooling, e.g. Rillet

  • Experience with complex businesses (multiple products with different revenue models)

  • Experience with business combination accounting and integrations

  • An active CPA license

jobs.jobDescription:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

Role Type: Full-time
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Reports To: Head of People
Comp: $110,000 - $150,000

About Claude Corps

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Cohorts now run in the hundreds, and new fellows onboard while earlier cohorts are still placed. We need an HR partner who can support fellows and their managers year-round and run onboarding at that scale.

About the role

You are the HR partner to Claude Corps program leaders and the AI Practice Leads who manage fellows day to day. You will own onboarding quality and deadlines for each cohort while Sr People Operations Coordinator, reporting to you, runs the day-to-day execution.

Your focus shifts throughout the year. As a cohort prepares to start, you spend more time running onboarding and completing the work alongside the Sr. People Operations Coordinator. Once fellows are placed, you spend more time advising managers, addressing employee concerns, and supporting performance. New cohorts will onboard while earlier cohorts are still working, so you will need to balance both responsibilities.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You bring sound judgment to employee situations, help managers address issues early, and build clear processes as the program grows. You work closely with the Head of People, the recruiting team, program leaders, Finance, and our HR service providers.

As onboarding volume grows, you identify when additional support is needed, define that work, and train and oversee the people helping deliver it. You remain accountable for onboarding quality and deadlines.

What you’ll do

Partner with program leaders and managers

  • Advise program leaders and AI Practice Leads on performance, employee concerns, role expectations, and team needs, and help managers set clear expectations and address problems early
  • Clarify who owns what between fellow managers, host organizations, and the program team when employee questions arise
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend changes to manager guidance, policies, or how the program operates

Manage employee relations and performance issues

  • Handle employee concerns with care and consistency: gather the facts, document clearly, and bring significant issues and recommended actions to the Head of People
  • Guide managers through performance conversations, improvement plans, and conduct issues
  • Manage leave and accommodation requests with the appropriate providers and advisors

Own fellow onboarding

  • Run onboarding for each cohort, from signed offer through the employment steps needed to start: background checks, I-9 and work authorization, employee records, payroll setup, and benefits enrollment
  • Confirm work locations and coordinate state notices and employment documents
  • Send clear instructions, track each fellow’s progress, and work with recruiting and program teams to resolve missing information, changes, and delays
  • Complete onboarding tasks directly, check that records and setup are accurate, and keep employment onboarding aligned with orientation and cohort start dates

Plan and oversee onboarding support

  • Manage the Senior People Operations Coordinator: set priorities by cohort, review their work, and keep sensitive questions and decisions with the right HR owner
  • Plan onboarding workload against cohort size, deadlines, and support needed for current fellows, and flag when volume requires surge help
  • Build checklists and repeatable processes so larger cohorts onboard with less manual work

Support fellows throughout the year

  • Be an HR contact for questions about benefits, leave, workplace concerns, and employment policies
  • Help managers and fellows resolve timekeeping issues and coordinate payroll corrections with Finance and our providers
  • Maintain accurate employee records as work locations or employment details change
  • Coordinate fellowship completion, early departures, and offboarding
  • Track recurring questions and improve guidance so fellows and managers know what to do

Maintain policies and employment practices

  • Keep the Fellow Handbook, manager guidance, and state supplements current with the Head of People and appropriate advisors
  • Coordinate multistate employment requirements and help managers understand the rules for hourly, nonexempt employees
  • Apply policies consistently and seek legal or specialized advice when a situation calls for it

Improve HR processes and reporting

  • Track onboarding readiness, open tasks, and employee issues, and give the Head of People clear updates on risks, workload, and recommended actions
  • Use approved AI tools and automation to cut repetitive work in communications, tracking, and reporting, while checking accuracy and protecting employee information

Requirements

  • At least seven years of progressive HR experience, including time as an HR business partner advising managers on performance, conduct, and sensitive employee situations
  • You have personally run onboarding at volume and can move between advising leaders and doing the operational work
  • You have supported employees across multiple states, including hourly, nonexempt employees
  • You understand how HR records, payroll, benefits, leave, and onboarding connect. PEO experience is a strong plus
  • You have managed or trained staff doing HR or onboarding work
  • You can build structure in a growing program while handling overlapping deadlines and day-to-day employee needs
  • You communicate clearly, document well, and know when to involve the Head of People or a specialist
  • You have improved HR processes using technology, AI, or automation

Key success metrics

  • Onboarding readiness: Fellows complete required employment steps on time, with accurate records and payroll and benefits setup
  • Manager support: Managers receive practical guidance and address performance and employee concerns promptly
  • Employee relations: Issues are handled consistently, documented clearly, and escalated at the right time
  • Balanced delivery: New cohorts onboard on schedule while current fellows and managers continue receiving timely HR support
  • Onboarding capacity: Support needs are identified early, assignments are clear, and work is checked for quality
  • Employment practices: Policies, records, and state requirements stay current, with gaps addressed promptly
  • Process improvement: Manual work and recurring errors decrease as cohort size grows

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a Senior level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$110,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home)

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption, C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.
    • Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
    • Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
    • Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.
  • RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.
    • Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
    • Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.
  • Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.
    • Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
    • Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
    • Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
    • Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)
  • Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.
    • e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
  • Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
  • Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$164,000—$240,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.jobDescription:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

We're ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, including how pay works. We work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows.

The role

Location: US, East Coast remote · Reports to: VP, People Foundations

You'll own Dataiku's global compensation, equity and benefits strategy. The goal: programs that win in AI talent markets, are fair inside the company, scale across 18 countries, and stay financially sustainable.

Our People function is lean and decentralized. You'll work directly with executives, Finance, Legal and the Compensation Committee, lead a small Total Rewards team, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you'll challenge how things are done today and use AI to reinvent how rewards work.

What you'll do

  • Set the strategy. Own and evolve our global compensation philosophy, balancing market competitiveness, internal equity and financial discipline.
  • Lead pay transparency. Define our global approach and get the company ready for new rules, including the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
  • Build the foundations. Evolve our job architecture, leveling and salary ranges, with rigor but without bureaucracy, and give managers simple tools to make good pay decisions.
  • Partner on equity. Design grant guidelines, new-hire and refresh awards, and partner with Finance and Legal on modeling, dilution and international tax.
  • Advise the top. Bring clear recommendations to executives and present equity and executive comp to the Compensation Committee and Board.
  • Run the cycles. Lead merit, promotion and incentive cycles from modeling to execution, with scalable governance and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Own global benefits. Set strategy across entities and EOR countries, and lead the benefits team that runs day-to-day operations.

What we're looking for

  • Extensive Total Rewards or compensation experience (typically 10+ years), ideally in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company.
  • Deep expertise in global comp strategy: salary structures, benchmarking, incentive design and job architecture.
  • Strong equity experience across countries; late-stage private company experience is a big plus.
  • Hands-on knowledge of pay transparency in Europe and North America.
  • A track record of building or transforming rewards programs, not just running them.
  • Experience leading teams and influencing senior executives in lean, fast-moving environments.
  • Strong analytical and modeling skills, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus).

Bonus points: knowledge of UK and French benefits and pension programs.

Why join us

  • Real impact: shape Total Rewards for a global AI company helping the world's largest enterprises make AI work.
  • Ownership: the autonomy to build, with direct access to executive decision-makers.
  • Growth: help reinvent how People programs are delivered, with AI-powered workflows.

#LI-Remote #LI-FR1

Compensation and Benefits

The final compensation package for this role will be determined during the interview process and is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, geographic location, internal equity, education, skill set, experience and training. Eligible roles may also be entitled to receive commission or other variable compensation through Dataiku's incentive compensation program.

Dataiku also offers comprehensive benefits, including stock options, medical, dental, and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, a 401k company match, paid vacations and sick leave, paid parental leave, employer paid disability coverage, and additional health and wellbeing perks and benefits. Dataiku reserves the right to amend or modify employee perks and benefits at any time.

US only national base pay ranges

$230,000—$260,000 USD

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

jobs.jobDescription:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

Why Brain Co.

You'll help build the financial-services business alongside the people developing and deploying the products. Your judgment will help determine which opportunities we pursue, how we win them and which recurring customer needs should shape the product.

Brain Co. builds AI systems that help large, regulated institutions carry out complex work. Our mission is to rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About the Role

Build Brain Co.'s financial services business, from the first buyer conversation to a signed engagement. You'll originate opportunities and lead consultative sales through close, working with the GM of Financial Services, product, engineering and deployment teams.

Our priority markets are banking & lending, asset & wealth management, and real estate investors. The work spans complex investment and core operational processes where agentic orchestration of people and data can dramatically improve speed, quality and business outcomes.

What you'll own

  • Create demand. Help shape our pitch and narrative, open doors and build a pipeline through targeted outreach, executive and industry relationships, partners, conferences and events. Choose the right accounts, earn substantive meetings and turn follow-up into sales qualified opportunities.

  • Discover and qualify. Convert marketing-generated and self-sourced leads into sales-qualified opportunities. Test the problem, economics, buyer, funding path and timing; know when to pursue, nurture or decline. Bring technical partners in early on data, security and implementation constraints.

  • Build the value case. Establish the customer's baseline and agree what improvement matters. Build clear briefs and proposals, partner with product and deployment on tailored demonstrations, and test the economic assumptions.

  • Lead the deal through close. Coordinate buyer and internal teams through scoping, pricing, security and legal review, procurement and negotiation. Validate commitments with product and deployment owners, then carry agreed scope, success measures and assumptions into a clear delivery handoff.

  • Inform what gets built. Distill recurring prospect needs, buying signals, objections and product gaps into recommendations for product strategy and roadmap priorities.

  • Build a repeatable sales motion. Keep account plans and forecasts accurate, learn from wins and losses, and create materials and practices that improve the next pursuit.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of relevant experience. You bring experience in enterprise sales, business development or management consulting, with direct accountability for originating opportunities and independently driving complex commercial engagements through close.

  • Complex multimillion-dollar closes. You've personally sold and closed custom technology deployments or tailored technology engagements, shaping bespoke solution scope, navigating implementation tradeoffs, building a quantified value case, negotiating contracts and aligning delivery commitments.

  • Financial-services sales and domain depth. You've sold into financial services and can speak credibly about banking & lending, asset & wealth management, and real estate investing. You bring deep expertise in at least one of these markets.

  • Practical AI and technical fluency. You use AI in your own work, verify its outputs and can discuss data, integrations, evaluation and human oversight with buyers and technical partners.

  • Commercial judgment and execution. You create access, write clearly, put compelling materials together and keep several pursuits moving. You lead across teams without formal authority and do the detailed work yourself.

Bonus Points for

  • Experience selling AI products. You've won business for AI products or solutions and understand how customers evaluate, buy and deploy them.

  • Entrepreneurship. Experience building commercial motion and trusted relationships in a 0->1 startup environment.

Location and Travel

San Francisco, New York, or Remote. Remote candidates should be comfortable traveling to our San Francisco office 1–2 times per month.
